subject: gk
question: How many major ports are there in India for maritime transportation?
solution:
The correct** **answer is** __13__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India has **13 major ports.**
 
• These ports are crucial for maritime transportation and trade.
 
• They handle a significant volume of cargo and container traffic.
 
• Major ports are administered by the** Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.**
 
• **The 13 major ports are:** Kandla (Deendayal), Mumbai, Jawaharlal Nehru (Nhava Sheva), Mormugao, New Mangalore, Cochin, Chennai, Ennore (Kamarajar), Tuticorin (V.O. Chidambaranar), Visakhapatnam, Paradip, Kolkata (Syama Prasad Mookerjee), and Haldia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• India also has 217 non-major ports.
 
• The major ports are strategically located along the western and eastern coasts of India.
 
• These ports play a vital role in India’s economy, **handling around 95% of the country’s trading by volume and 70% by value**.
 
• **Minor ports are administered by the State Maritime Boards or relevant departments of the respective state governments**. These boards manage the operations, development, and regulation of minor ports within their jurisdictions.
